0022600220.text: The San Antonio Spurs (9-2, 1st in the Southwest, on a nine-game winning streak with a 5-0 road record) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East, on a seven-game losing streak) for the Spurs' 12th game of the season. Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for San Antonio, and Devin Vassell (groin) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Chicago's Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) are also day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Spurs swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating Chicago 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30.
